context.purpose: Automatically lay out named directed dependencies and feedback flows with editable DOT and independently inspected geometry.
context.assumptions: Graphviz dot 16.1.0; declared simple directed topology; fixed monochrome boxes and plain ASCII labels.
context.constraints: 2–200 nodes, 1–500 unique nonself edges, TB/LR directions; DAG or explicit cyclic policy; no arbitrary DOT, native flags, clusters, URLs, images or HTML.
context.inspection: Inspect graph.svg, graph.dot, native graph.plain and host layout.json. Literal topology and labels are independent expectations; SVG/plain coherence shares the same layout engine.
context.recovery: GRAPH_CYCLE: remove feedback or choose graphPolicy cyclic. INVALID_GRAPH_EDGE: choose unique distinct declared endpoints. INVALID_GRAPH_LABEL: use short supported ASCII. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND: configure dot 16.1.0.

workflow.scope: Verified layout JSON values can feed declared downstream graph fields; all artifacts remain explicit publications.

composition.scope: Shared document references and finite TB/LR studies resolve before the same literal graph contract.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline covers version, layout and final inspection. Native CPU 30s, address space 512MiB, file 8MiB; every evidence read bounded 4MiB.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned-process group cancellation and publication cancellation check. Failed runs retain explicit failed status.
lifecycle.logs: Authored/effective plans, trusted DOT, launchers, native input hashes, exact command submissions, stdout/stderr, SVG/plain and checked layout JSON.
lifecycle.verification: Literal declared node/edge multiplicity and labels; positive finite native bounds, fixed boxes, separated interiors, attached spline endpoints and DAG direction invariants. Closed SVG grammar rejects extra/hidden content; all box/spline geometry compared with plain inches→72points and inverted y. No optimality or rendered typography claim.

losses: Fixed monochrome design; no measured typography or optimal crossing claim.

losses: External DOT edits are outside verified execution.
